text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Flash, you made an Umatter
account?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your recommendation, yes.
You said it
was vital to my life as an
Umamusume, and a
service I owe to my
fans, correct?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Our fans are always cheering us
on, so we
should give them a little cheer
through our posts
too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So what're you posting about anyway?
Let me
see...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
12:30 Beginning lunch. Status: On
schedule.
14:40 Beginning independent
training.  Status:
On schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've also discovered that Umatter posts
are an
excellent way to maintain my
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Although it does annoy me when the
post's
timestamp is a few seconds off
from the moment I
intended.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Y-your Umatter looks like an itinerary...
